content: Servers RequestResponseDelay for received FindService entries The Server will delay the OfferService answer to a received multicast FindService entry by the configured SomeipSdServerServiceInstanceCon- fig . requestResponseDelay . The actual delay will be randomly chosen between the maxValue and minValue .
